#!/usr/bin/env python3 """Audit .mdx, .md, and .astro files for unpaired
tags.""" import os import re import sys from pathlib import Path PAGES_DIR = Path("/Users/samforeman/projects/saforem2/sam.onl/web/src/pages") EXTENSIONS = {".mdx", ".md", ".astro"} # Patterns: # 1. Self-closing div:
— skip these # 2. Opening div: (may span multiple lines) # 3. Closing div:
# # Strategy: read entire file, find all div-related tags with their positions, # then map positions back to line numbers. # This regex matches: # - Self-closing divs: ]*/\s*> # - Opening divs: ]*> (that are NOT self-closing) # - Closing divs: TAG_RE = re.compile( r']*/\s*>' # self-closing
r'|]*>' # opening
r'|', # closing
re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE, ) SELF_CLOSING_RE = re.compile(r']*/\s*>', re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE) CLOSING_RE = re.compile(r'', re.IGNORECASE) def line_number_of_offset(text: str, offset: int) -> int: """Return 1-indexed line number for a character offset.""" return text[:offset].count("\n") + 1 def get_context(lines: list[str], lineno: int, context: int = 2) -> str: """Return a few lines of context around lineno (1-indexed).""" start = max(0, lineno - 1 - context) end = min(len(lines), lineno + context) snippets = [] for i in range(start, end): marker = " >> " if i == lineno - 1 else " " snippets.append(f" {marker}{i + 1:>5} | {lines[i].rstrip()}") return "\n".join(snippets) def audit_file(filepath: Path) -> list[dict]: """Audit a single file. Returns list of issues.""" text = filepath.read_text(errors="replace") lines = text.split("\n") issues = [] # Stack holds (line_number, match_text) for each unmatched opener stack: list[tuple[int, str]] = [] for m in TAG_RE.finditer(text): tag = m.group(0) offset = m.start() lineno = line_number_of_offset(text, offset) # Skip self-closing if SELF_CLOSING_RE.fullmatch(tag): continue if CLOSING_RE.fullmatch(tag): # Closing tag if stack: stack.pop() else: issues.append({ "type": "extra_closer", "line": lineno, "tag": tag.strip(), "context": get_context(lines, lineno), }) else: # Opening tag stack.append((lineno, tag.strip()[:80])) # Anything left on the stack is unclosed for lineno, tag in stack: issues.append({ "type": "unclosed_opener", "line": lineno, "tag": tag, "context": get_context(lines, lineno), }) return issues def main(): all_issues: dict[str, list[dict]] = {} file_count = 0 for root, _dirs, files in os.walk(PAGES_DIR): for fname in sorted(files): fpath = Path(root) / fname if fpath.suffix.lower() in EXTENSIONS: file_count += 1 issues = audit_file(fpath) if issues: rel = fpath.relative_to(PAGES_DIR) all_issues[str(rel)] = issues print(f"Scanned {file_count} files under web/src/pages/\n") if not all_issues: print("No unpaired div tags found.") return total_issues = sum(len(v) for v in all_issues.values()) print(f"Found {total_issues} issue(s) in {len(all_issues)} file(s):\n") print("=" * 80) for filepath, issues in sorted(all_issues.items()): print(f"\n FILE: {filepath}") print(f" Issues: {len(issues)}") print("-" * 80) for issue in sorted(issues, key=lambda x: x["line"]): if issue["type"] == "extra_closer": label = "EXTRA
(no matching opener)" else: label = "UNCLOSED
(no matching closer)" print(f"\n Line {issue['line']}: {label}") print(f" Tag: {issue['tag']}") print(f" Context:") print(issue["context"]) print() print("=" * 80) # Summary table print("\n\nSUMMARY TABLE") print("-" * 80) print(f" {'File':<55} {'Unclosed':>10} {'Extra':>10}") print("-" * 80) for filepath, issues in sorted(all_issues.items()): unclosed = sum(1 for i in issues if i["type"] == "unclosed_opener") extra = sum(1 for i in issues if i["type"] == "extra_closer") print(f" {filepath:<55} {unclosed:>10} {extra:>10}") total_unclosed = sum( sum(1 for i in v if i["type"] == "unclosed_opener") for v in all_issues.values() ) total_extra = sum( sum(1 for i in v if i["type"] == "extra_closer") for v in all_issues.values() ) print("-" * 80) print(f" {'TOTAL':<55} {total_unclosed:>10} {total_extra:>10}") if __name__ == "__main__": main()
